flags.message: Forecast is driven by two companion petitions on the same 9/28/2026 conference: Hadley v. City of South Bend (No. 25-1158, CA7) and Pena v. City of Los Angeles (No. 25-1163, CA9), both raising the police-power exception to the Takings Clause that the CA7 opinion here applies by name. Their dockets (read from supremecourt.gov; CourtListener carries no entries for them) show no relist, CVSG, or disposition as of this run. Legitimate pre-snapshot forward signal, disclosed because it is decisive: most of my grant mass is a hold-and-GVR trailing those cases.

distribution_count = 2 here reflects the Apr 28 distribution that was pulled when a response was requested on Apr 30, plus the Jul 15 post-response redistribution; the petition has not been relisted in the ordinary sense. The elevated band and relist-1 bucket therefore read a reschedule-shaped count as a relist, which the statpack's relist-count caption already warns about. No action needed; noted so the evaluator can weigh the band anchor accordingly.
